fact: CIPC invited bids (closing 6 February 2026) for an AI-powered multi-channel transactional chatbot to serve its clients, with a 36-month contract.
title: Invitation to Bidders to Submit Proposals for the Implementation of an AI-powered Multi-channel Transactional Chatbot for the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC)
publisher: Companies and Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC bid 10/2025/2026), via Tender Bulletins
